creator: Alexander Terp
description:
Resizing the Muster window garbles a running TUI: Claude Code re-wraps against its old geometry and stays broken. The same agent under `ghostty > herdr > claude` redraws correctly on resize, so the pane's program is fine and something between the surface and the daemon is not.

Where it should already work: the bridge blocks SIGWINCH, waits on it in a thread, and on each one reads the pty size and sends `terminal.resize` on herdr's control stream (crates/muster-bridge/src/main.rs:94, pty.rs:39). Nothing in that path logs, so a run cannot say whether the signal arrived, whether the size read was right, or whether herdr acted on it - which is the first thing to fix regardless of the cause.

Candidates, cheapest first: the surface's pty never sees SIGWINCH because libghostty resizes it differently than a terminal app expects; the size read races the signal and reports the old geometry; herdr's `terminal.resize` needs something we are not sending. Decide it by recording what herdr does with a resize on the control stream, the way the other adapter facts were recorded.

Reported from a real window, 2026-08-15.
title: 🔄 A resized window never reaches the daemon
